title: Thin as cheap plastic!
text: Thin as cheap plastic!. So thin, one sleep will wear these out. The elastic on the fitted sheet corners are like a cheap rubber band. I could probably find better quality at a dollar store! Junk!!

product_metadata.title: Linen Market 4 Piece Queen Bedding Sheet Set (Gray Scallops) - Sleep Better Than Ever with These Ultra-Soft & Cooling Bed Sheets for Your Queen Size Bed - Deep Pocket Fits 16" Mattress
features: LUXURIOUS SLEEP: Get ready to sleep in cloud-like comfort every night with your new luxurious twin sheets. Softer than cotton sheets, cozy and comfortable, they're the perfect way to treat yourself to a sound sleep.

WHAT MAKES OUR SHEETS DIFFERENT: Most bed sheet fabrics are only brushed once to soften them up, but to make sure you get the best night’s sleep, we brush our fabric TWICE. Tuck yourself into these cloud-like sheets and soundly drift off to sleep every night.

EASY SHEET CHANGES: Changing sheets on deep beds is frustrating, but not with our 16” deep pocket sheets. Our snug-fit design allows for you to easily put your fitted sheets on without the hassle of wrestling down every corner. This set includes a fitted and flat sheet, and two pillowcases.

CONFIDENTLY DURABLE: Pets, kids, and family life can take a hard toll on sheets and other bedding, but our microfiber twin size sheets are made to last. Expert stitching and seams ensure that your durable twin sheet set stands up to wear and tear for years to come.

BEAUTIFUL BED SHEETS: Our unique Coarse Paisley print is sure to add a touch of elegance and brighten up your bedroom. Check all 19 of our popular color options in all 5 size options to find the perfect match for every bedroom in your home.
description: iEnjoy Home is designed with your comfort in mind. Made of the finest double-brushed microfiber yarns creating a new standard in softness and breathability. Our premium yarns are two times more durable than cotton, completely wrinkle-free, and perfect for all seasons.
